summary: This first Secret History class is already foundational public feedstock for Power As Alchemy: Jiang defines reality as trained imagination, names power as the capacity to turn nothing into everything, and routes money, the individual, school, and the nation-state through that mechanism.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Power is a capacity to turn nothing into everything.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The episode read and public Power page already use this source as the core definition of power as trained imagination made socially real.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Money is made to feel scarce through poverty, crisis, war, and artificial misery so people keep working inside the system.
existing_lens_links.rationale: This is a direct match for the public Power anchor on scarcity as labor discipline.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Modern individualism makes distress private, routes it through games, pornography, therapy, and expert dependence, and disables collective action.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The episode read already links the individualism section to the public privatized-distress anchor.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: School separates the child from parents, makes the teacher the replacement trust object, and then installs national authority.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The episode links directly to the Education anchor for school as family-separation and authority-transfer machinery.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: History is the false memory of a nation-state that trains students to love, obey, fight, and die for an imagined national person.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Power page already uses this source for the national-memory branch of the alchemy mechanism.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Money, the individual, and the nation-state are trained abstractions beyond ordinary first-principles experience.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The source already anchors the atlas relation among Power, Education, Nation, and neighboring lens families.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: preserve this 2025-08-21 lecture as the origin spine for Power As Alchemy, where imagination is the battlefield and money, the individual, and the nation-state become lived reality through trained belief.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Power As Alchemy owns the conversion of invented abstractions into operating reality. Stories owns narrative capture, Education owns school formation, Nation owns national-body divinity, and Dead World owns cave ontology when those are the active mechanisms.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: use the money section for scarcity discipline, not a standalone banking page. Jiang's banking, receipts, central-bank, poverty, crisis, and war chain explains how expandable money is made scarce enough to command labor.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Debt As Sovereignty and Dollar Hegemony own later reserve-order and obligation machinery. This source belongs on Power because the active object is the initial conversion of money into social reality and labor discipline.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep the individualism section as privatized-distress evidence, where modern agency language converts communal vulnerability into private pathology and disables collective action.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Human Heart owns concrete recognition and relationship; Free Will owns agency and chosen responsibility. Power owns the abstraction layer when individualism is used to isolate suffering and prevent collective action.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: this source supports the school-separation anchor, where school removes the child from family trust, installs teacher authority, and trains loyalty to the nation-state.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Education owns school as formation and authority-transfer game. Power owns the larger alchemy by which the nation-state and official history become real.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use this source as background evidence when the Nation page next enters replacement/compression: school teaches language, history, and geography until an imagined national person can demand love, obedience, service, and death.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Nation owns the national person and sacrifice demand. Power owns the upstream abstraction-to-reality mechanism, and Education owns the school apparatus that installs it.

new_lens_seeds.title: Monotheism As Abstraction Engine
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Jiang frames monotheism as the revolution in thought that later makes money, the individual, and the nation-state plausible abstractions rather than natural facts.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The line likely matters for later Secret History lectures on Judaism, Christianity, Islam, and modern institutions, but this first class explicitly marks it as setup that will be developed later in the semester.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold as a seed only. Do not create a standalone Monotheism page from the first class; compare later Secret History religion lectures before deciding whether this is a child concept, Religion/Eschatology extension, or Power chronology note.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2025-08-21, this is the first Secret History class and the current earliest public definition spine for Power As Alchemy: Kantian imagination, implanted school history, money creation, privatized individualism, national memory, and the closing power-as-alchemy formula are all introduced as course-opening scaffolding.

The monotheism claim is explicitly promissory in this class: Jiang says later classes will show how monotheism created money, the individual, and the nation-state, so this source should not be treated as the fully developed religion or eschatology argument by itself.

The opening course method predates the later 2026 Prediction page sources: Jiang says the class will build analytical models of past, present, and future, make predictions, and test the model against reality.

canon_candidates.candidate: Power is the capacity to turn nothing into everything by training imagination until invented abstractions such as money, the individual, and the nation-state become lived reality.
canon_candidates.promotion_condition: Only promote through the canon path after comparing the later Secret History lectures that develop monotheism, money, individualism, nation-state memory, and liberation; keep current public concept prose as the working lens.

next_actions.action: No immediate public prose mutation is needed; Power As Alchemy already carries this source's definition spine and durable anchors. Future Power work should be replacement/compression only, not another ordinary append.

When later Secret History religion lectures receive impact, compare them against the held `monotheism-as-abstraction-engine` seed before creating a public child page or rewriting Religion/Eschatology/Nation boundaries.

If Prediction method chronology is revised, treat this source as an early classroom formulation of model-building and testing, while leaving the public Prediction page focused on forecast audit, misses, and later comparison trails.

Do not create standalone Banking, Artificial Scarcity, Individualism, School Brainwashing, Nation-State Memory, or Monotheism pages from this source alone; route each by active mechanism through the existing Power, Education, Nation, Religion, Eschatology, and Prediction surfaces.
